messages.plugin.name: AI File Reader
messages.plugin.description: Read published PDF, Word and Excel files for normal AI search.
messages.plugin.sidebar.label: AI File Reader
messages.review.title: Review file reading
messages.review.stale: The original was replaced, deleted or is no longer available. This result cannot be registered.
messages.review.empty: No readable text was obtained. Discard this result and replace the original if necessary.
messages.settings.description: Configure automatic reading and inspect recent processing states.
messages.settings.disclosure: Published originals are sent to the selected AI provider. Reading has separate connection settings and API costs. Save and test the connection before automatic processing.
messages.settings.shared: Explicitly reuse the common AI connection
messages.settings.saved: Settings saved. Test the saved connection after changing it.
messages.settings.test_success: The synthetic PDF and structured response test passed.
messages.settings.test_failed: The file-reading capability test failed. Check the saved endpoint, model, credentials and file-input support.
messages.settings.queued: A scan was queued. Automatic reading must be enabled and the connection test must pass.
messages.issue.incomplete_extraction: The provider could not confirm complete extraction.
messages.issue.incomplete_unit_coverage: Some input text units were not acknowledged exactly once.
messages.issue.incomplete_page_coverage: Page coverage does not match the original.
messages.issue.page_count_unverified: The original page count could not be independently verified.
messages.issue.empty_extraction: No readable body text was obtained.
messages.issue.provider_read_failed: The AI request failed, timed out or returned an invalid response.
messages.issue.invalid_extraction_response: The extraction response had an invalid structure.
messages.issue.file_size_limit: The original exceeds the configured file-size limit.
messages.issue.page_limit: The PDF exceeds the configured page limit.
messages.issue.text_input_limit: The extracted input exceeds the text-processing limit.
messages.issue.extracted_text_limit: The extraction result exceeds the storage limit.
messages.issue.configuration_changed: The reading connection changed during processing.
messages.issue.embedded_visuals_unread: Embedded images, charts or objects were not read. Check the original.
messages.issue.formula_without_cached_value: A formula has no saved calculated value; formulas are not executed.
messages.issue.legacy_workbook_visuals_unverified: Legacy Excel cell values were read; embedded visuals and full formula source need review.
messages.issue.word_special_content_unverified: The Word document contains special or revision content needing review.
messages.issue.invalid_office_archive: The Office archive is invalid or damaged.
messages.issue.unsupported_office_archive: The Office archive is encrypted, unsupported or exceeds expansion limits.
messages.issue.invalid_office_xml: An Office XML part could not be safely read.
messages.issue.invalid_workbook: The workbook could not be fully parsed.
messages.issue.workbook_cell_limit: The workbook exceeds the cell-processing limit.
messages.issue.invalid_shared_string: A workbook text reference is invalid.
messages.issue.invalid_word_document: The Word document could not be parsed.
messages.issue.provider_file_input_rejected: The provider rejected this file request. Check PDF/file input and structured-output support for this model and endpoint.
messages.issue.provider_authentication_failed: The provider rejected the configured credentials.
messages.issue.provider_rate_limited: The provider rate or usage limit was reached.
messages.issue.worker_interrupted: The worker stopped before completion and exhausted its retries. Check server limits and review any recovered text.
messages.settings.changed: These settings changed. Reopen this dialog before saving or testing again.
messages.settings.destination_changed: The credential destination changed. Enter the key for the new destination, or explicitly clear the saved key.
messages.settings.test_busy_message: Checking image reading and response format with a synthetic PDF using the saved connection. Please wait for the result (request limit: {seconds} seconds).
messages.settings.failure_credentials_missing: No API key is saved. Enter and save a key before testing again.
messages.settings.failure_model_or_endpoint: The model or API endpoint was not found. Check the saved settings.
messages.settings.failure_provider_unavailable: The AI provider is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
messages.settings.failure_timeout: The request reached its {seconds}-second limit. Check the provider response time and request timeout.
messages.settings.failure_tls: TLS certificate validation failed. Check the server CA certificates and the endpoint certificate.
messages.settings.failure_connection: Could not connect to the AI provider. Check the endpoint URL, DNS and the server's outbound network settings.
messages.settings.failure_endpoint_policy: This endpoint is not allowed by the outbound connection policy. Check HTTPS and the endpoint settings.
messages.settings.failure_http_client: The server HTTP client is unavailable. Check the PHP cURL extension.
messages.settings.failure_ocr: The text in the synthetic PDF image was not read correctly. Check that the selected model supports reading images inside PDF files.
messages.error.reviewChanged: Review has already changed. Reopen it.
messages.error.reviewNoText: No extracted text is available. Replace the file before registration.
messages.error.httpsUrl: A valid HTTPS provider URL is required.
messages.error.officialEndpoint: OpenAI requires its official Responses API endpoint.
messages.error.sharedUnavailable: Shared AI connection settings are unavailable.
